records.note: No prison-housing data found for Kerala within budget. Wikipedia full-text search ('transgender prisoners Kerala') surfaced no article covering trans-prisoner placement in Kerala. Two candidate fetches were checked and cached: the Wikipedia article 'LGBTQ people in prison' has no India section at all, and the Wikipedia article 'Transgender rights in India' documents Kerala's Transgender Welfare Board and the Devu G v. State of Kerala (2023) healthcare-ruling case law but contains no rule, case or practice on where trans prisoners are housed. No Kerala-specific statute, prison-department order or documented case on trans-prisoner placement was located in the audited sources; record additional only if a Kerala prison policy/order surfaces.

No prison-housing data found for Assam within budget. Wikipedia full-text search ('transgender prisoners Assam') surfaced no article on trans-prisoner placement in Assam. Candidate fetches checked and cached: the Wikipedia article 'LGBTQ people in prison' contains no India section, and 'Transgender rights in India' covers national welfare-board setup and case law but no prison-placement practice; the only Assam-specific material in it concerns same-sex-marriage opposition, not prisons. No Assam statute, policy or documented case on where trans prisoners are housed was located in the audited sources; record additional only if an Assam-specific source surfaces.
